story.value: The name manganese comes from the Latin word magnes, meaning magnet, because the mineral pyrolusite has magnetic properties.
Manganese was isolated by Gahn in 1774.

uses.value: Manganese is mixed into steel to make it easier to form and work with, and to make it stronger and more resistant to impact.
Manganese is used to give glass an amethyst color.
Manganese dioxide is used in dry cells.
Manganese dioxide is used as a drying agent in black paints.
